editorialSummary.heading: A full homecoming holiday and two separate March breaks
highlights: October 2 is a full student holiday; February 19 has early release
Spring Break March 13-21; classes resume before Good Friday
Graduation May 22; fourth-quarter early release May 27
paragraphs: Hardee’s homecoming/fall holiday on Friday, October 2 is a full day off for students. The staff days have different effects: September 18 and October 14 have no student classes, while February 19 is a shortened student day followed by staff inservice. The other early-release dates are November 20, December 18, March 12 and May 27, so families have five pickup schedules to confirm with their schools.

The named Thanksgiving and spring breaks both include the weekends on either side. Thanksgiving Break is November 21-29, with a scheduled November 30 return. Spring Break is March 13-21, and students are scheduled back March 22. Good Friday follows on March 26, after four scheduled class days; it forms a separate three-day weekend. Winter Break ends January 3, but January 4 is a student-free records day and students return January 5.

Reporting dates are useful to keep alongside the breaks. Progress reports arrive four times during the year, and report cards are listed for October 21, January 14, March 31 and May 26. Graduation falls on Saturday, May 22, before the May 27 fourth-quarter finish and early release. Summer school is listed separately for June 1-30, with individual attendance arrangements left to the schools.

The September 18 Staff Inservice and January 4 Records Day events are explicitly categorized No School for STUDENTS in the page’s structured calendar content. May 27 has one canonical fourth-quarter-end/early-release occurrence; its CALENDAR_END classification and finalStudentDate are derived from that entry and May 28 Teacher Post Day. Graduation on Saturday May 22 does not establish regular Saturday classes or a separate senior last day. Regular attendance is calculated as 208 weekdays minus 28 confirmed no-school weekdays = 180; the PDF does not print an annual student-day total. The five shortened dates count once each. Report-card grades-due dates October 15, January 8, March 25 and May 20 are staff deadlines and are excluded; issued dates October 21, January 14, March 31 and May 26 are retained. August employee start/inservice/professional days, May 28 post day, July 3 and May 31 employee/after-year holidays are excluded. The six school-specific open-house entries have separate audience/time sources and do not create class days. faqs.question: When does school start and end in Hardee County?
faqs.answer: Students begin Tuesday, August 11, 2026. May 27, 2027 is the final regular student date indicated by the calendar: it ends the fourth quarter with early release, followed by a teacher post day May 28.

faqs.question: When are open houses at each school?
faqs.answer: Hilltop Elementary meets August 6, 2-4 p.m.; North Wauchula Elementary meets August 6, 10 a.m.-noon. On August 7, Hardee Senior High welcomes freshmen 9-11 a.m. and grades 10-12 from 1-3 p.m.; Hardee Junior High welcomes grades 6-8 with last names A-L from 10 a.m.-noon and M-Z from 2-4 p.m.; Zolfo Springs Elementary meets 10 a.m.-noon. Wauchula Elementary meets August 10, 9-11 a.m. Complete online registration forms before open house.

faqs.question: Is homecoming a day off for students?
faqs.answer: Yes. Friday, October 2, 2026 is the Homecoming/Fall Holiday, with no students or staff. It is a full student holiday, giving families October 2-4 off with a scheduled Monday, October 5 return.

faqs.question: When is Thanksgiving break?
faqs.answer: Thanksgiving Break runs November 21-29, 2026, including both weekends. Students have early release Friday, November 20 and are scheduled to return Monday, November 30. The break contains five weekdays without classes.

faqs.question: When do students return from winter break?
faqs.answer: Students return Tuesday, January 5, 2027. Winter Break is December 19, 2026-January 3, 2027, and January 4 is a separate records day with no student classes. Together, the planned time off runs December 19-January 4, a 17-day stretch.

faqs.question: When is spring break, and are there classes before Good Friday?
faqs.answer: Spring Break is March 13-21, 2027. Students are scheduled to return Monday, March 22 and attend March 22-25. Good Friday on March 26 is a separate student holiday. March 12 has early release before spring break.

faqs.question: Which dates have early release?
faqs.answer: The five dates are November 20 and December 18, 2026, then February 19, March 12 and May 27, 2027. October 2 is a full holiday, and October 8 is a regular first-quarter-end day without an early-release marking.

faqs.question: What time do students leave on early-release days?
faqs.answer: The verified annual calendar does not give dismissal clock times. Check your school for its early-release schedule, bus pickup and after-school arrangements. A dismissal time from the previous school year may not apply to these dates.

faqs.question: Is February 19 a full student holiday?
faqs.answer: No. Friday, February 19, 2027 has student early release followed by staff inservice. Students attend the shortened day; the inservice entry does not cancel the whole school day.

faqs.question: Which in-year staff days have no student classes?
faqs.answer: Students have no classes September 18 and October 14, 2026, and January 4, 2027. January 4 is Records Day. February 19 has early release instead of a full student day off.

faqs.question: Are Labor Day, Martin Luther King Jr. Day and Presidents Day student holidays?
faqs.answer: Yes. Students are off Monday, September 7, 2026 for Labor Day; Monday, January 18, 2027 for Martin Luther King Jr. Day; and Monday, February 15, 2027 for Presidents Day. The next Tuesdays are not listed as additional student holidays.

faqs.question: Is Veterans Day a school holiday on this calendar?
faqs.answer: November 11, 2026 is listed for progress reports and is not marked as a student holiday. The published district schedule treats it as a regular class date.

faqs.question: Is Good Friday a full day off?
faqs.answer: Yes. Friday, March 26, 2027 is a full student holiday. With the weekend, students are off March 26-28 and are scheduled to return Monday, March 29.

faqs.question: When do the four grading quarters end?
faqs.answer: Quarter-end dates are October 8 and December 18, 2026, then March 12 and May 27, 2027. December 18, March 12 and May 27 have student early release. October 8 does not.

faqs.question: When are progress reports issued?
faqs.answer: Progress reports are scheduled for September 14 and November 11, 2026, then February 5 and April 21, 2027.

faqs.question: When are report cards issued?
faqs.answer: Report cards are scheduled for October 21, 2026, January 14, March 31 and May 26, 2027. These are the family-facing issue dates. The separate grades-due deadlines are for staff and do not change student attendance.

faqs.question: When is graduation, and does it end the school year?
faqs.answer: Graduation is listed for Saturday, May 22, 2027. Contact Hardee Senior High for the time, location, rehearsal and guest arrangements. Other students still have scheduled classes May 24-27, with early release May 27. The district PDF does not establish a separate last class day for seniors.

faqs.question: When does summer school meet?
faqs.answer: The calendar lists summer school June 1-30, 2027, with a Juneteenth holiday on June 18. It does not give a daily timetable or weekly meeting pattern. Ask your school which dates your child should attend, how to enroll and how the holiday affects the program.

faqs.question: How many student attendance days are scheduled?
faqs.answer: The regular calendar works out to 180 planned attendance weekdays: 208 weekdays from August 11 through May 27, less 28 no-school weekdays. This is a calculation from the dated schedule, not an annual total printed in the PDF. Early-release days count as attendance days; open houses, graduation and summer school do not add regular-year days.

faqs.question: Where can I download the official calendar and check for changes?
faqs.answer: The district’s Calendar page links the 2026-2027 Printable Calendar PDF, which prints Board approval on August 13, 2026. Check district News, Live Feed and school announcements for later schedule changes. The PDF does not designate reserved weather make-up dates.
